abilities.name: Aspect of Death
abilities.description: Deathwing is fitted with 4 Armor Plates which grant 10 Armor each. Every 25% Health lost causes Deathwing to lose a plate. Plates are only restored when Dragonflight is used, based on the amount of Health Deathwing has when landing. Deathwing is also a mighty Dragon Aspect who is permanently Unstoppable and deals 100% additional Spell Damage to Heroes, but views his allies with contempt and ignores any of their friendly effects.; trait

fields.type: Defensive damage modifier, Offensive damage modifier, Status effect
fields.notes: Deathwing uses Energy instead of Mana as a resource. Deathwing has 100 max Energy, which regenerates at 5 Energy per second (even while channeling Molten Flame). Deathwing can still be affected by allied and enemy Time Stop and pathing blockers and by enemy non-crowd control debuffs, like Attack Slows, Damage over time, Damage modifier, Healing modifier, Revealed, Armor debuffs and hero specific debuffs that are not tied to applying a crowd control effect on the target. Deathwing cannot be eaten by Zagara's Devouring Maw (but its pathing blocking properties still work). Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Deathwing's damage. Armor bonus stacks additively with itself, but not with other Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack. Deathwing does not heal while in the Hall of Storms or after casting Hearthstone. Deathwing can heal himself by using Dragonflight, benefiting from Regeneration Globes, using Healing Fountains, and by selecting certain talents.

abilities.name: Molten Flame
abilities.description: After 1.5 seconds, Deathwing breathes a stream of flame, dealing 20 damage every 0.125 seconds. Drains 30 Energy per second.

fields.notes: Molten Flame is usable in both forms. Molten Flame can be canceled 0.75 seconds after successfully casting it to end its effect early.

abilities.name: Destroyer Incinerate
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, Deathwing flaps his wings, dealing 100 damage to nearby enemies. World Breaker : Lava burst Create a lava pool that damages and Slows.

abilities.name: World Breaker Lava Burst
abilities.description: After a 0.75 second delay, deal 35 damage to all enemies in the area and create a pool of magma that deals 28 damage per second and Slows enemies by 45%. Lasts 6 seconds. Destroyer : Incinerate Damage enemies near Deathwing.

abilities.name: Destroyer Onslaught
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, Deathwing lunges in a direction, dealing 60 damage to enemies and Slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds. Deathwing bites enemies at the end of the lunge, dealing an additional 120 damage. World Breaker : Earth Shatter Damage and Stun enemies in two lines.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd Control / Movement: Dash
fields.props: Area of Effect, Piercing Skillshot, Slow
fields.notes: After dash the hitbox lingers for 0.25 seconds. 0.0625 seconds after that it impacts the half-circle at the end of the hitbox and another 0.0625 seconds later it deals the bite damage.

abilities.name: World Breaker Earth Shatter
abilities.description: Create a fissure of earth that deals 90 damage to enemies hit and Stuns them for 0.75 seconds. Destroyer : Onslaught Lunge in a direction.

abilities.name: Cataclysm
abilities.description: After 2 seconds, Deathwing flies in the targeted direction, dealing 90 damage on impact and leaving scorched ground that deals 36 damage a second. Lasts 6 seconds. Questonly Hit Heroes with Molten Flame to grant 3 stacks. Quest Score Takedowns to grant 50 stacks. After reaching 2000 stacks, Deathwing brings on the Hour of Twilight. Cataclysm's periodic damage to Structures is increased by 2500%.

fields.notes: Starts on a 270 second cooldown at the beginning of a match. Disjoints projectiles such as most ranged Basic Attacks as well as Experience Globes which were moving toward Deathwing. Can be used to enter out-of-bounds areas by landing exactly perpendicular to and with the end of the launch being exactly on the edge of Terrain.

abilities.name: Dragonflight
abilities.description: After 3 seconds, fly into the sky, becoming immune to all effects and gaining 2.5% Health per second. Once cast, this Ability cannot be interrupted. Cannot be cast for 6 seconds after taking damage, Basic Attacking or casting an Ability.

fields.notes: Taking damage only prevents using the Ability. Once it has been activated it cannot be interrupted. Last indefinitely until Destroyer or World Breaker are used. While in the air, enemies will be alerted by occasional roars.

abilities.name: Dragonflight Destroyer
abilities.description: After 1.75 seconds, Deathwing slams down to the ground, dealing 50 damage to enemies in the area and landing in Destroyer form. Deathwing can begin to cast Abilities 3 seconds after landing.

fields.notes: Cannot be cast on a point that is out of vision. Begins on cooldown when Dragonflight is cast. If Hero-created Terrain is placed in the landing zone after this is cast, it can prevent Deathwing from using his W and E Abilities until he next lands (correctly). This happens most often with Hogger Loot Hoard placed in the landing area.

abilities.name: Dragonflight World Breaker
abilities.description: After 1.75 seconds, Deathwing slams down to the ground, dealing 50 damage to enemies in the area and landing in World Breaker form. Deathwing can begin to cast Abilities 3 seconds after landing.

fields.notes: Cannot be cast on a point that is out of vision. Begins on cooldown when Dragonflight is cast. If Hero-created Terrain is placed in the landing zone after this is cast, it can prevent Deathwing from using his W and E Abilities until he next lands (correctly). This happens most often with Hogger Loot Hoard placed in the landing area.
